messages.content: Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?

function.name: science_history_get_invention
function.description: Retrieve the inventor and year of invention based on the invention's name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

want_year.description: Return the year of invention if set to true.

message.content:
**Answer:**  
Albert Einstein is credited with inventing the theory of relativity. His first major work—introducing what we now call *special relativity*—was presented in 1905 (in his paper “Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Körper”). Later, in 1915, he extended this framework into *general relativity*, but the foundational theory was first published in **1905**.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?" We need to answer with Einstein and the year (1905 or 1915?). The question likely refers to Einstein as the inventor of the theory of relativity. But there are two theories: special relativity (1905) and general relativity (1915). The question might refer to the original theory of relativity (special relativity) introduced in 1905. So we should mention Albert Einstein and the year 1905 for special relativity. If they want general relativity, it's 1915. But the question says "the theory of relativity" singular; historically, Einstein published his paper on special relativity in 1905. So answer: Albert Einstein, 1905.

We can also provide context: He published "Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Körper" in 1905. Then he developed general relativity in 1915. But the question only asks who invented it and in which year. So answer: Albert Einstein, 1905.
